LanguageData.Cosmere_Roshar_SeekNightwatcher_Desc: Send {PAWN_nameDef} on a journey to seek the Nightwatcher, daughter of Cultivation, who dwells in the peaks beyond the edge of the world. She will grant a boon, any wish, and in return, will take something of her own choosing.
LanguageData.CRO_NW_Tier1_Desc: Small gifts - a sharpened skill, a shifted temperament. The Nightwatcher gives these freely.
LanguageData.CRO_NW_Tier2_Desc: Substantial changes - healed wounds, expanded capacity. These carry a heavier curse.
LanguageData.CRO_NW_Tier3_Desc: Transformative power - bonds unlocked, minds awakened. The Old Magic exacts its highest price.
LanguageData.CRO_NW_Opening_Text:
{PAWN_nameDef} has made the long journey into the mountains and descended into the valley where the Nightwatcher dwells. The air is still. The light is wrong. Something vast and patient turns its attention toward {PAWN_nameDef}.
"I have come to ask a boon," {PAWN_pronoun} says.
The Nightwatcher does not speak in words. But {PAWN_pronoun} understands, somehow, that she is listening.
LanguageData.CRO_NW_Boon_RowTip: Choose this boon. The Nightwatcher grants what is asked, and takes what she wills.
LanguageData.CRO_NW_Boon_RowChoiceTip: This boon takes more than one form. Click to pick which.
LanguageData.CRO_NW_Boon_NoSelection: Nothing asked for yet. She waits.
LanguageData.CRO_NW_Boon_ConfirmNeedsChoice: Choose which form this boon takes before asking.
LanguageData.CRO_NW_Curse_Text:
The boon settles over {PAWN_nameDef} like a second skin. {PAWN_pronoun} can already feel it. The {BOON_label}. The change. It is real.
Then the Nightwatcher reaches for something else.
She does not ask permission. She never does.
LanguageData.Cosmere_Roshar_Nightwatcher_Evolution_De:
{PAWN_nameDef}'s curse, the {CURSE}, has changed. Cultivation has been patient. She has been watching. And now, after years of carrying this weight, {PAWN_pronoun} has been shaped by it in ways even the Nightwatcher did not intend.
The curse has not been lifted. But something within it has grown.
